name: Iceland
oneLineFragment: Black volcanic sands and glacial tongues under low northern sun.
narrativeStory:
Steam rising from geothermal fissures across black basalt gravel fields. The silence of the Icelandic highlands is absolute, broken only by the calving roar of Vatnajökull.

Glacial melt streams weave braided ribbons of cobalt across obsidian sandbars before vanishing into the icy froth of the Atlantic.
subtitle: Southern Volcanic Coast & Glacial Lagoons
introLines: Black volcanic sands stretching toward grey horizon.
Glacial lagoons holding thousand-year-old blue ice.
Rhyolite mountains glowing under midnight sun.

frames.caption: Diamond beach ice crystals stranded on black volcanic sand
Skógafoss waterfall spray catching low arctic morning light
Rhyolite ridges of Landmannalaugar painted in ochre and moss
Reynisfjara basalt sea stacks emerging from thunderous white foam
Ancient sod turf church nestled beneath glacier tongues
